verdict.rationale: Sentry documents release management through its CLI, deploy notifications, Bitbucket Pipelines build notifications, and suspect commits. Together these give the basic deploy/commit-to-error linkage needed to tie regressions to releases. Configuration-change tracking is not evidenced; the LaunchDarkly item only sends Sentry errors into experiments, not flag changes into Sentry. Missing for 10: configuration/feature-flag change tracking in Sentry, explicit docs on release health or regression-to-release comparison views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
